notes: Two surfaces: (1) @inngest/agent-kit Networks/Agents/Routers/State for multi-agent TS orchestration; (2) Inngest durable execution where each model/tool call is step.run() with checkpoint/replay—agents as durable workflows without declaring a graph. HITL via step.waitForEvent, sub-agents via step.invoke, trajectories from step traces. Complements AI SDK/Mastra rather than replacing typed UX layer.
cognitive_tax_note: Low CTI for teams already on Inngest: durable loop is 'normal code + steps'. Higher if learning AgentKit Networks + Inngest platform together.
